title: Graph API token dies about weekly with OAuthException 190 subcode 460
symptoms: Session has been invalidated because the user changed their password or Facebook has changed the session for security reasons
cause: A user access token is bound to the user's Facebook session. A password change or Facebook's periodic session rotation invalidates it.
fix: Use a system user token with expiration set to Never for server-side jobs.
apply: Business Settings > Users > System users > select the system user > Generate new token > choose the app > Token expiration: Never
affected: Graph API and Marketing API, June 2026
